name: Bangla Disaster Response QA
description: Artefacts for a CPU-only, fully offline evaluation of six compact open-weight LLMs on Bangla disaster-response QA: 634-item human-verified benchmark with per-item safety labels, 64-item adversarial answerability probe, 2,058 human accuracy judgements, a refuse-by-default wrapper, and the evaluation pipeline (ICCIT 2026).
